<style>
.form-container {
  max-width: 800px;
  margin: 20px auto;
  padding: 25px;
  background: #ffffff;
  border-radius: 8px;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
}

.form-group {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
  background: #f8fafc;
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  transition: background 0.3s ease;
}

.form-group:hover {
  background: #f1f5f9;
}

.form-label {
  min-width: 120px;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  margin: 0;
  background: #e2e8f0;
  border-radius: 4px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #4a5568;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  text-align: center;
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
  border-left: 3px solid #63b3ed;
}

.form-input {
  flex: 1;
  margin-left: 1rem;
  padding: 0.8rem;
  border: 2px solid #cbd5e0;
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-size: 1rem;
  background: white;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.form-input:focus {
  border-color: #63b3ed;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(99, 179, 237, 0.2);
  outline: none;
}

.form-input::placeholder {
  color: #a0aec0;
  opacity: 1;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .form-group {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: stretch;
    padding: 0;
    background: transparent;
  }

  .form-label {
    width: 100%;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    border-radius: 4px 4px 0 0;
  }

  .form-input {
    margin-left: 0;
    border-radius: 0 0 4px 4px;
  }
}

.form-input[readonly] {
  background-color: #f8f9fa;
  border-color: #e2e8f0;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

.form-input[readonly]:focus {
  box-shadow: none;
  border-color: #e2e8f0;
}

.required::after {
  content: "*";
  color: #e53e3e;
  margin-left: 4px;
}

.form-input:required:invalid {
  animation: shake 0.5s;
}

@keyframes shake {
  0%, 100% { transform: translateX(0); }
  25% { transform: translateX(5px); }
  75% { transform: translateX(-5px); }
}

.attachments-section {
  margin-top: 2rem;
  border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  padding-top: 1.5rem;
}

.section-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.add-button {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
  background: #3b82f6;
  color: white;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 4px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.3s;
}

.add-button:hover {
  background: #2563eb;
}

.grid-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 1fr);
  gap: 1rem;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  background-image: linear-gradient(to right, #e2e8f0 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(to bottom, #e2e8f0 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size: calc((100% - 5*1rem)/6 + 1rem) 100%, 100% 100%;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
}

.grid-col {
  position: relative;
  border-right: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  padding-right: 1rem;
  background: rgba(241, 245, 249, 0.3);
  border-radius: 4px;
  transition: transform 0.2s;
  min-width: 150px;
  padding: 0 0.5rem;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
}

.file-upload {
  display: block;
  position: relative;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.file-input {
  position: absolute;
  opacity: 0;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
}

.upload-text {
  display: block;
  padding: 0.75rem;
  background: #f8fafc;
  border: 2px dashed #cbd5e0;
  border-radius: 4px;
  text-align: center;
  color: #64748b;
  transition: all 0.3s;
}

.file-input:focus + .upload-text,
.file-input:hover + .upload-text {
  border-color: #3b82f6;
  background: #eff6ff;
}

.file-name {
  display: block;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: #64748b;
  margin-top: 0.25rem;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .grid-row {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }

  .grid-col {
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  }
}

/* 响应式调整 */
@media (min-width: 1024px) {
  .grid-row {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(6, minmax(120px, 1fr));
  }
}

@media (max-width: 1023px) and (min-width: 768px) {
  .grid-row {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  }
}

@media (max-width: 767px) and (min-width: 480px) {
  .grid-row {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }
}

@media (max-width: 479px) {
  .grid-row {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .grid-col:last-child {
    grid-column: span 1;
  }
}

.grid-col:last-child {
  border-right: none;
  padding-right: 0;
}

.grid-header {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(6, minmax(150px, 1fr));
  gap: 1rem;
  margin: 1rem 0;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #2d3748;
  background: #f8fafc;
  padding: 0.8rem;
  border-radius: 4px;
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 1;
}

.grid-container {
  overflow-x: auto;
  background: 
    linear-gradient(90deg, #fff 30%, rgba(255,255,255,0)),
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,0), #fff 70%) 100% 0,
    radial-gradient(farthest-side at 0% 50%, rgba(0,0,0,.1), transparent),
    radial-gradient(farthest-side at 100% 50%, rgba(0,0,0,.1), transparent);
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  background-size: 40px 100%, 40px 100%, 14px 100%, 14px 100%;
  background-attachment: local, local, scroll, scroll;
}

.grid-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(6, minmax(150px, 1fr));
  gap: 1rem;
  min-width: 900px; /* 保证最小宽度 */
  padding: 0.8rem;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: white;
  transition: transform 0.2s;
}

.grid-row:hover {
  transform: translateX(4px);
  box-shadow: 2px 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
}

/* 文件列特殊处理 */
.grid-col:last-child {
  min-width: 200px;
}

/* 响应式处理 */
@media (max-width: 1200px) {
  .grid-header {
    font-size: 0.9rem;
  }

  .grid-row {
    min-width: 800px;
  }
}

/* 滚动条样式 */
.grid-container::-webkit-scrollbar {
  height: 8px;
}

.grid-container::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
  background: #f1f5f9;
}

.grid-container::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: #cbd5e0;
  border-radius: 4px;
}

.grid-container::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
  background: #94a3b8;
}

</style>
